experiments.paper_location: Section 4.3 Equations 9-11; Section 4.4 attention execution support
experiments.mechanism: Actual selected sparse/full QK, probability correction, Softmax, weighted-value and server bodies against independent dense FP64 expectations on supplied candidate multisets.

conditions.execution: portable software FP32 lanes; optional capability-gated actual AVX512F/FMA selected arithmetic
conditions.seed: fixed deterministic literal formulas, no RNG
conditions.sparse: two layers, two batches, two KV heads, two query groups; dimensions 16/32/128; nnz 1/15/16/17/31/32; valid capacity 32 and initialized padding; distinct unsorted or repeated candidate IDs
conditions.full: dimension128 groups1/4/8; two batches/twoKV/two layers; lengths16/32 differ across query groups, KV heads and individual query heads; flattened query-head nnz applies to all stages.
conditions.oracle: Independent arithmetic BF16 decoding, dense FP64 dots/norms, explicitly enumerated Binomial(4,p) >=2 with K=3, released +1e-4 regularizer, normalization, weighted V and base-2 maximum/LSE.
conditions.bf16_adapter: Explicit finite-value software dependency model: pinned FBGEMM uint32 bits+0x8000 then >>16, not ties-even. Actual FBGEMM intrinsics, dispatch and linkage untested.
conditions.tensor_adapter: Explicit non-owning contiguous std-only buffers; queries already FP32; Tensor.to is identity. No Torch dtype conversion, ABI or allocation claim.
conditions.threading: OpenMP pragmas execute serially without OpenMP runtime; production scheduling/races untested
conditions.tolerances: pre-Softmax corrected scores 3e-5 on both modes; portable probability 3e-5, output 0.004 including BF16 quantization, base2 metadata 5e-5; native probability 0.002, output 0.008, metadata 0.03 as existing polynomial bootstrap budget
conditions.native_capabilities: AVX512F and FMA with confirmed GCC CPU/OS gate before execution
conditions.empty_server_policy: Repair #73: empty heads return zero BF16 output, -infinity base2 max/LSE and unchanged score rows; mixed-empty static/dynamic/full fixtures across two layers/batches; empty sparse norms not read.

experiments.note: Support characterization, not exact paper replication or end-to-end LSH/model validation. Actual same-data all-candidate corrected sparse and dense pipelines each match their own oracle and differ as expected because inclusion correction remains. fill copies storage; getter views alias live server; clear is observed through existing views; alloc called once per server and destructor sanitizer checked.

experiments.paper_location: Sections 4.3-4.4; released CPU kernel capacity/dimension support boundaries
experiments.mechanism: Defined-memory QK/full-softmax padding characterization and explicit dimension/group rejection regressions.

conditions.capacity: Repair #75 exact logical candidate/score allocations plus guarded logical scores; server score stride remains capacity32.
conditions.padding_observation: QK touches only logical nnz; preexisting capacity padding remains unchanged. Full softmax padding remains characterized pending #74.
conditions.dimension_observation: Repair #76: FP32 QK/WV reject nonpositive/nonmultiple16 dimensions before reads/writes; dimensions near16/32/128 checked.
conditions.full_group_observation: Repair #76: full server and fixed WV reject dimensions other than128 or groups outside1/4/8 before writes; valid groups remain FP64 checked.
conditions.empty_candidates: QK nnz0 permits null buffers; server empty heads bypass correction and return zero output/-infinity metadata without score writes; nativeBF16/scheduled server source paths updated but not runtime exercised.
conditions.invalid_parameters: Full server dimension/group, layer, count-vector rank/length and all logical counts validated before writes; unsupported shapes/ABI/dtype beyond model remain untested.
conditions.varying_gqa_lengths_observation: Repair #77 original [16,16,16,16,32,32,32,32] regression produces dense1.0; general varying GQA lengths checked against FP64 probability/output/base2 metadata in two layers/batches.
conditions.caller_domain_validation: Repair #67 shared scratch staging of actual QK+transform before exposed writes/OpenMP;26 later-head/domain regressions in static/dynamic calls preserve all score/output/metadata buffers. BF16/scheduled paths reuse but native server dispatch unexecuted.

experiments.note: Repairs #73/#75/#76/#77 enforce empty server policy, logical QK bounds, supported dimensions/groups and query-head nnz routing. Softmax tails remain tracked by #74.
